ValidationRule.description: Cannot change Status if set to Modification in Progress
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Cloud_uAssist_Order", NOT($Permission.Bypass_uAssist_Status_Validation),
ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), "Modification in Progress") && ( ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "In Progress") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Model Prep Complete") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Model Prep in Progress") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Tech Review") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Modification Requested") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Cancel") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Rejected") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Case ready to review") || ISPICKVAL(uAssist_Status__c, "Completed") ) && CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "uAssist") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Hello - you cannot change Status if set to Modification in Progress
